parent_context:
12. A school currently has a cabled network but wants to add wireless networking across
the whole campus.
(a) Describe two hardware components the school will need to implement the
wireless network. [4]
(b) Identify two advantages to the students of the new wireless network. [2]
There are concerns that unauthorized people could access the data on the wireless network.
(c) Outline two methods the school could employ to prevent network data from being
accessed over their wireless system. [4]
The school has decided to implement a virtual private network (VPN) to provide access
to its network.
(d) Identify two technologies the school would require to provide a VPN. [2]
(e) Explain one benefit to the staff of using a VPN to remotely access the school network. [3]
